title: The Hedge Maze
text: A hedge maze stands in the middle of nowhere, perfectly kept, its walls trimmed square, dark green and taller than a horse. No gardener is in sight. By the way the hedges lean inward, something worth finding lies at its heart, along with something that does not want to be found.

options.label: The cleverest leads the way through, determined to reach its heart.

outcomes.text: They lead you straight to the heart, where a fountain holds coins. Of the gardener there is no sign, at least none you can see.
The maze quietly changes behind you, and keeps changing. Something walks the paths you left.

options.label: The strongest cuts straight through the hedges. No maze will hold you.

outcomes.text: The hedges bleed red sap. The gardener is very upset, and very close.

options.label: Go around it, and leave its heart to whatever guards it.

outcomes.text: It is a very big maze. As you walk, it seems to grow bigger.
